question.problem:
$$
U=[\begin{aligned}-\frac{4}{\sqrt{17}} & \,∗\, \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{17}} & \,∗\,\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrix $U$ shown above. Given that $A=UΣ{V}^{T}$ is a singular value decomposition of a $2\times 2$ matrix $A,$ which of the following could be the second column of the matrix $U?$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that since $A=UΣ{V}^{T}$ is a singular value decomposition of a $2\times 2$ matrix $A,$ the matrix $U$ must be a $2\times 2$ orthogonal matrix. This means that 

- the first column must be orthogonal to the second column, and

- the norm of the second column must be equal to $1.$

Among the given options, only the vector $[\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{\sqrt{17}} \\ \frac{4}{\sqrt{17}}\end{aligned}]$ has both properties.
